A total of 16 teams will compete in the league. The season began on 31 July 2021 and is scheduled to conclude in May 2022.{{cite web |url= https://www.thairath.co.th/sport/thaifootball/thaipremierleague/2055112 |title=ประกาศ : ดีเดย์ ไทยลีก 2021/22 เปิดฤดูกาล 31 ก.ค.64 พักเบรก "ซูซูกิ คัพ" |work=thairath.co.th |publisher=Thairath |date=22 March 2021}} The 1st transfer window is from 4 May to 27 July 2021 while the 2nd transfer window is from 8 December 2021 to 4 January 2022.
